text:
Ana Torres: Heads-up: PR #30321 CI is failing on embed-index tests (linux + mac). Looks flaky — fails in 2 different shards with `IndexConstructionTest::test_sparse_embeddings` and a snapshot mismatch. Blocking merge, need eyes.
Matt Nguyen: I can approve but would rather not blindly update snapshots. Can we run a targeted rerun first?
Liam Patel: +1. If it's infra/flakiness we should avoid snapshot churn. Anyone have failing log snippet?
Ana Torres: Pasting failing lines:
```
AssertionError at build/test/embeddings/index_test.cc:73
  expected vector_size == 1024, got 0
Snapshot diff: expected `vector_size: 1024` but found `vector_size: 0`
```
Sophia Chen: I saw something similar yesterday on shard4. Pattern looked like cold-start zeroed vectors when KV cache wasn't warmed. Might be a race with index writer buffer.
Ryan Blake: I'll kick a targeted rerun for shards 3,4 now: `./scripts/ci-targeted-rerun --pr 30321 --shards 3,4`
ci-bot: Buildkite: Started targeted rerun for PR 30321 (shards 3,4) — build 4521 
ci-bot: Build 4521 (shard3) ✅ passed, Build 4521 (shard4) ❌ failed — same test: `IndexConstructionTest::test_sparse_embeddings`. Logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/4521
Matt Nguyen: Ok failing persisted on shard4. If reruns keep failing we should avoid merging and either quarantine test or fix. @Sophia can you triage and propose next step?
Sophia Chen: I'll dig in now. If it's deterministic we can patch + add a unit to catch it; otherwise quarantine the test and add a follow-up. Might need to repro locally on a cold VM.
Ana Torres: Per policy we need 2 approvals to merge without all green CI. @Matt do you want to approve to unblock, or hold?
Matt Nguyen: I'll hold off approving until we have a clear plan. Don't want post-merge regressions.
Liam Patel: I left a PR comment asking the author to add a small nonzero-vector assertion to snapshots if they update them. Also requested a repro checklist for local dev.
Ryan Blake: Noted — snapshot update would be last resort. Also, if we do update snapshots, please include `assert(vector_size > 0)` in the test to avoid silent zeros.
ci-bot: Build 4521 finished — overall status: FAILED. Failing tests: IndexConstructionTest::test_sparse_embeddings (shard4). Full logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/4521/logs
Ana Torres: Ok leaving merge blocked until fix. @Matt thanks for holding. @Sophia please post ETA when you have one.
Sophia Chen: Narrowed it down: race in index writer when buffer pool isn't warmed on cold VMs, sometimes writes zeroed vectors. I have a small fix that adds a buffer warmup + defensive check. Will open a patch + unit test in ~2 hours.
Ana Torres: Great — plan: (1) Sophia pushes fix + unit, (2) Ryan or author re-run targeted CI, (3) Matt will approve after green CI. I'll file a follow-up ticket to track flaky test quarantine if needed. Thanks all.
